COMPLETELY CONNECTED. EFFORTLESSLY ENGAGING.
The most technologically advanced Mazda is also equipped with the most technologically advanced cockpit. With functionality
at your fingertips thanks to the available multi-function Commander control, you can easily control audio and navigation
functions—among other things—and see it all on the Mazda3’s available high-mounted 7-inch full-color touch-screen display. Now
you can enjoy a host of entertainment options without ever taking your eyes off the road, from the available next-generation Bose®
Centerpoint® 2 Surround Sound System, to the available SiriusXM Satellite Radio,* integrated Pandora® and Stitcher™ internet
radio, and so much more. Plus, you get convenient standard features like USB audio input ports, remote keyless entry and
Push Button Start.
/ BLUETOOTH HANDS-FREE PHONE AND AUDIO STREAMING /
With voice commands, making and receiving calls is as easy as pushing a
button and saying "hello." And the Bluetooth wireless capability helps you
stay entertained with streaming audio from your compatible mobile device.
/ MAZDA NAVIGATION SYSTEM /
Get where you need to go with the Mazda3’s available factory-integrated
navigation system. Its advanced features include voice command and
advanced lane guidance.
/ INTEGRATED PANDORA® INTERNET RADIO /
Experience music on your terms with up to 100 unique “stations” through
Pandora, all seamlessly streaming through your wireless Bluetooth-enabled
and Internet-connected device, and controlled through any of the Mazda3’s
built-in audio controls.
/ HD RADIO /
With subscription-free HD Radio, you get cleaner, crisper sound from a digital
signal that offers multiple options for some of your favorite AM and FM stations.
/ SMS TEXT MESSAGE AUDIO DELIVERY AND REPLY /
When a text comes in while you’re driving, you can stay focused on the road
ahead. Enjoy fully integrated text display and audible readout, and the ability to
reply by choosing from a number of customizable preset return messages.
/ INTEGRATED AHA™ RADIO /
Download the Aha app to your smartphone and stream Aha’s wide array of
Internet content via the Mazda3’s Bluetooth connectivity. Access everything
from Internet radio and podcasts, Facebook, Twitter and personalized music to
audio books, weather, local restaurant and hotel searches, and more. The system
even reads the content displayed on the monitor aloud.
/ INTEGRATED STITCHER™ INTERNET RADIO /
Discover the best of news, entertainment, sports and talk radio—anytime,
anywhere! Now available on the 2014 Mazda3, Stitcher internet radio offers
more than 15,000 radio shows and podcasts on demand. This free app is
available for your iPhone,® Android device and iPad.®
/ 7-INCH FULL-COLOR TOUCH-SCREEN DISPLAY AND COMMANDER CONTROL /
Thanks to the newly adopted multi-function Commander control on the center console,
all of the functions displayed on the 7-inch full-color display screen—such as audio,
navigation and hands-free telephone—are positioned close at hand so you can better
concentrate on the drive. The intuitive rotary and push-and-tilt operations of the Commander,
as well as the simple push buttons around it, enable smooth and easy operation.
*SiriusXM Satellite Radio reception requires a subscription and Mazda satellite radio. See full disclaimer in Specifications.

C
IN TUNE WITH YOU IN EVERY SENSE.
We believe the connected driving experience should encompass every sense, including your sense of hearing. That’s why
for the Mazda3, we settled for nothing less than the latest generation Bose® Centerpoint® 2 Surround Sound System.
A A
The available system with 9 speakers enables listeners to enjoy a surround sound experience from nearly any stereo
source, including CDs, MP3 devices, radio broadcasts and SiriusXM Satellite Radio*. It has been specifically engineered to
meet the unique demands of reproducing surround sound for the Mazda3’s interior dimensions. And unlike conventional
synthesized surround sound systems that compare left and right channel information to create a virtual surround
experience, Centerpoint® 2 technology uses frequency content in addition to the stereo information to create a more
lifelike surround experience. While AudioPilot® 2 technology compensates for ambient noise within the cabin.
